title: I Call It Evolution
text: The “pussyfication” of America? I blame the fathers who weren’t there — and I praise the mothers who raised those boys the best they could. Those mothers gave a different kind of love than a boy would have gotten with his father around. I don’t use the term pussyfication. I call it evolution — evolution from the neanderthalistic attitude that was displayed and accepted. title: Showing Up Anyway
text: Did you realize everyone is busy with their own lives and only reach out when it’s either beneficial to them personally or to their social status perception? I mean really dwell on why you contact someone. It seems that no matter how benevolent you truly are, there is a sliver of selfishness attached to your actions… you can try and refute it but wouldn’t that be your pride intervening? title: Where I’ve Been
text: So yeah… I haven’t been around much. Not out with people, not online like I used to be. It started back in April last year. I figured I’d bounce back quick. Reasonable timeline, back to normal, back to life. It turned into something longer. Two herniated discs in my neck. Two more in my thoracic spine. A fractured pinky. Shoulder impingement.
